decision: Do not bind these remnant images to the unchanged passage on the current evidence. The NIRCam caption identifies expanding material colliding with gas shed by the progenitor before explosion. That does not establish the passage claim that much of the pictured bright edge was never inside the star. The MIRI caption describes surrounding circumstellar material but does not independently resolve its origin in favor of the passage.
limits: Read primary source captions; no new delivery downloaded or inspected. Existing Nova imagery and all literal prose untouched. This is a pairing hold, not a claim that the passage can never be supported by another source.
